I downloaded Brawlhalla thinking it was just a free Smash Bros. clone.

I was wrong.

It's a game where you can have the perfect strategy, read your opponent five times in a row, and still get launched off the map because you missed one recovery.

Every match is a mix of skill, chaos, and wondering how that one attack somehow hit you from across the screen.

The best part is how easy it is to pick up but how hard it is to actually master. You can start playing in minutes, but learning movement, combos, reads, and weapon matchups takes forever.

You'll have games where you feel like a pro.

You'll have games where you question if your controller is working.

Then you'll queue again anyway.

That's Brawlhalla.

Simple to learn. Painful to master. Impossible to play "just one more game."
